PACTO_DASHBOARD_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS.description: Serve beyond loopback without sign-in; everyone who reaches the address reads the whole fleet

PACTO_DASHBOARD_DECLARE_REGISTRY_CONFIG.description: A Docker config.json with push access to the registry, the dashboard's own push credential; a shared dashboard without it only plans declarations and shows the command

PACTO_DASHBOARD_DELIVERY_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace Pacto delivery runs in, whose published identity policy the dashboard reads

PACTO_DASHBOARD_DELIVERY_TRUST.description: Trust config delivery records are verified with, so History reads signed records (the recorder's PEM public key or a YAML trust config)

PACTO_DASHBOARD_FULCIO_URL.description: Fulcio to get the signing certificate from

PACTO_DASHBOARD_MCP.description: Serve MCP to agents at /mcp with the dashboard's sign-in: a Kubernetes token (token sign-in) or, with an issuer and PACTO_DASHBOARD_MCP_EXCHANGE_AUDIENCE, an issuer token exchanged for the cluster

PACTO_DASHBOARD_MCP_EXCHANGE_AUDIENCE.description: The audience asked for when exchanging an issuer token, one the API server accepts. With it, every token from the dashboard's issuer must name the MCP URL as its audience; without it every token is checked as a Kubernetes token

PACTO_DASHBOARD_MCP_URL.description: The /mcp URL as agents reach it (absolute http(s), path exactly /mcp), the RFC 9728 resource; empty: the request's own address, token sign-in only

PACTO_DASHBOARD_MIRA_URL.description: Mira's address, to link health-check citations and open a service in Mira

PACTO_DASHBOARD_NAMESPACE.description: Kubernetes namespaces to read, comma-separated (empty = all)

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: OpenID Connect client id of the dashboard

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OpenID Connect client secret of the dashboard

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_DISPLAY_NAME.description: The identity provider's name on the sign-in button, as in Sign in with Keycloak (default OIDC)

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_EXTRA_SCOPES.description: Space-separated scopes beyond openid, profile and groups

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM.description: ID token claim the API server takes the groups from (default groups); must match its claim mapping

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_GROUPS_PREFIX.description: Prefix the API server puts before every group; must match its claim mapping

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_ISSUER_URL.description: OpenID Connect issuer people sign in with before the dashboard shows anything; every view then follows their Kubernetes RBAC

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_REDIRECT_URL.description: The dashboard's /auth/callback as browsers reach it

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_USERNAME_CLAIM.description: ID token claim the API server takes the username from (default sub); must match its claim mapping

PACTO_DASHBOARD_OIDC_USERNAME_PREFIX.description: Prefix the API server puts before the username (default the issuer URL and #, none for the email claim; - for none); must match its claim mapping

PACTO_DASHBOARD_REGISTRY.description: The registry declarations made in the dashboard are published to (<host>/<path>); without it the dashboard offers no Declare

PACTO_DASHBOARD_REKOR_URL.description: Rekor transparency log the signature is recorded in

PACTO_DASHBOARD_REVIEW.description: How signed-in people are reviewed: cluster asks once about every namespace and needs a ClusterRole; local asks in each PACTO_DASHBOARD_NAMESPACE only, and then services without a namespace show to nobody

PACTO_DASHBOARD_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: A session without a request for this long ends, as a Go duration (default 1h)

PACTO_DASHBOARD_SESSION_MAX_AGE.description: A session ends this long after sign-in, as a Go duration (default 12h)

PACTO_DASHBOARD_SIGN_CLIENT_ID.description: A second OpenID Connect client at the sign-in issuer whose ID tokens Fulcio accepts; a signed-in person logs in again with it to sign a declaration as themselves

PACTO_DASHBOARD_SIGN_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OpenID Connect client secret of the signing client

PACTO_DASHBOARD_SIGN_REDIRECT_URL.description: The dashboard's /auth/sign/callback as browsers reach it

PACTO_DASHBOARD_TIMESTAMP_URL.description: Timestamp authority to date the signature with

PACTO_DASHBOARD_TOKEN_LOGIN.description: Let people sign in with a Kubernetes token: a ServiceAccount token minted for the dashboard reads the fleet only, and a person's own token acts as them

PACTO_DASHBOARD_TRUSTED_ROOT.description: Sigstore trusted root JSON to verify with (default: public-good Sigstore)
